title: A Thousand Miles in a Single Jar
description: When a simple scent brings your entire childhood kitchen back into focus thousands of miles away from home.
engagement_comment: Share this with someone who misses home.
factory_topic: homesickness: Smelling the exact scent of woodsmoke and damp pine needles while opening a jar of imported maple syrup given by a neighbor from your hometown thousands of miles away.
